label: PhD
heading: PhD applicants
intro: We're glad to hear from students interested in human-centered computing, HCI, social computing, health informatics, privacy, and platform governance. Advising availability changes from year to year, so we can't promise an opening in any given cycle.
steps: Explore our research and recent publications to see where your interests fit.
Apply through Penn State's official doctoral admissions process and follow the program's current requirements.
If you'd like to reach out, tell us briefly about your research interests and how they connect to our work. Feel free to include a CV.
note: You don't need to meet with us before applying. Reaching out is welcome, but it doesn't by itself mean an advising or funding position is available.
